    👋 About Me

    Hi, I'm Sid - a hiker, backpacker, and travel enthusiast based in the Bay Area. When I'm not working on AI models, I'm out exploring trails, climbing summits, and experiencing new corners of the world. This site is where I document those adventures — through words, pictures, and soon, videos too!
